description:
Weighted Male Confidence Index (0-100) and the five domain scores (each 0-20) for Australian men,
    optionally split by a demographic (age_group, state, region, income, education, employment,
    household, housing, sexuality, or a single-choice question id such as Q15).

by.description: Optional demographic to split scores by, e.g. "age_group", "state", "income", or a single-choice question id such as "Q15". Omit for the national score only.
by.title: By

domain.description: Optional single domain to return. Omit for the index plus all five domains.
domain.title: Domain

name: mci_scores
title: Male Confidence Index: scores
